title: US500 completed-M15 shock-response environment correction

research_height.transfer_path: completed US500 M15 volatility-normalized shock -> four subsequent market-bar continuation/reversion proxy economics -> at most one standalone additive-prototype information seed

correction_not_successor.fault: Unit027 bound every required US500 monthly tick file from 2022-08 through 2026-08 to each individual path. Both otherwise stable P1 invocations were invalidated solely because the unrelated then-current 2026-08 tick file synchronized while the 2022-08 through 2023-12 path ran.
correction_not_successor.why_repair_is_required: The signal observer stopped normally twice with zero rate, tick and profit-calculation faults and produced the same 1,264-row structural output both times. The mutable irrelevant-file manifest was an environment-design fault, not economic evidence against either direction.
correction_not_successor.unit105_scope: Replace only the overbroad mutable tick-manifest authority with one immutable family-owned completed-M15 bar surface and a frozen bar-open/spread proxy. Preserve the parent signal, rearm, horizon, periods, volume, direction books, cost stress and selection gates exactly.

central_question: Under the exact Unit027 completed-M15 shock definition, does either continuation or reversion provide frequent, positive and sufficiently distributed US500 four-market-bar economics after one additional entry and exit spread, strongly enough to retain one later standalone-prototype information seed?

whole_map_recomparison.program_1: Selected only as an engineering completion of Unit027's still-unanswered fixed signal question. Unit102 body engulfing and Unit103 lead-lag are closed and no adjacent variant of either is reopened.
whole_map_recomparison.program_2: Unit104 broad-dollar state closed with 0/9 P1 gates and no seed. No adjacent dollar level, magnitude, lag, subindex, component or symbol state opens.
whole_map_recomparison.program_3: No new quote, placement, fill, latency, rejection, queue, occupancy or broker field exists; execution remains closed.
whole_map_recomparison.program_4: The fixed four-bar observation is a response horizon, not a held-position exit candidate. No stop, take-profit or exit state changes.
whole_map_recomparison.program_5: Weights, static reconstruction, capacity, risk caps, ladder, slots and portfolio drawdown interventions remain closed. Unit105 has fixed 0.01 observation volume and no portfolio reconstruction.
whole_map_recomparison.program_7: Structural parity and hashes are integrity inside Program1, not a diagnostic-only research unit.
whole_map_recomparison.after_close: Recompare Programs1-5 and7 and all heights. Do not automatically open another shock threshold, rearm, impulse window, baseline, horizon, session, direction subgroup, cost stress, symbol, period, stop, size or retained-seed successor.

live_dev_and_symbol_split_boundary.live_dev_data_role: Live-Dev supplied the current optimization context, but its canonical local sample remains only three complete lifecycles and 44 candidate rows, so it cannot support tuned selection. No Live file or broker surface is a Unit105 formal input.
live_dev_and_symbol_split_boundary.cancelled_us30_us100_us500_split: Unit105 is a self-contained US500 research correction and does not revive the cancelled physical EA split. It neither changes whether any US30/US100 strategy reads US500 nor claims a Tester-speed improvement.

boundary.one_time_parent_copy: Only six non-economic structural columns from one parent invalid P1 output were copied into the family-owned structural anchor before declaration. The proxy reads no other-family output.

pre_open_storage_correction.reason: The system drive had about 5.69 GiB free after reboot, too little for a dedicated hydrated history runtime.
pre_open_storage_correction.action: Marked the exact closed ignored Lab runtimes lab/runtime/rva96-portable and lab/runtime/us30-compression-break-response-v1-portable as OneDrive online-only with attrib +U -P. No file was deleted and both remain cloud-recoverable.

unit027_provenance.role: exact parent hypothesis periods and gates

structural_anchor.allowed_role: Engineering parity only. No entry, exit, spread, profit or other economic field exists in this copy.

fixed_observer.evaluation_clock: At each available US500 M15 bar open, use completed bars only.
fixed_observer.impulse: Natural log of Close[1] divided by Close[5], spanning the four immediately completed M15 market bars.
fixed_observer.baseline: Thirty-two one-bar log returns from Close[5]/Close[6] through Close[36]/Close[37]; sample standard deviation multiplied by sqrt(4).
fixed_observer.shock_score: Absolute impulse divided by positive four-bar baseline volatility.
fixed_observer.trigger: Shock score at least 2.0 while armed and with no unresolved observation.
fixed_observer.rearm: After a trigger, rearm only when a later completed-bar evaluation has score at most 1.0.
fixed_observer.horizon: Resolve on the fourth subsequent physical M15 market row. Gaps add no synthetic bars.
fixed_observer.overlap: At most one unresolved observation. A resolving row can update rearm state but cannot trigger again.
fixed_observer.continuation: BUY after positive impulse and SELL after negative impulse.
fixed_observer.reversion: SELL after positive impulse and BUY after negative impulse.

fixed_proxy_execution.bid: The acquired M15 open is the first-row bid proxy at trigger and resolution.
fixed_proxy_execution.ask: Bid plus that row's acquired spread points multiplied by the frozen symbol point.
fixed_proxy_execution.observed_buy: Open at trigger ask and close at resolution bid.
fixed_proxy_execution.observed_sell: Open at trigger bid and close at resolution ask.
fixed_proxy_execution.double_spread: Move the trigger open and resolution close against the direction by one additional observed spread each, exactly matching Unit027's stress arithmetic.
fixed_proxy_execution.profit: Signed price distance divided by trade tick size, multiplied by trade tick value and fixed 0.01 volume.
fixed_proxy_execution.rounding: Retain binary double precision through aggregation; no per-row currency rounding.
fixed_proxy_execution.authority_limit: This is an immutable bar-open/spread proxy, not real-tick fill evidence, Strategy Tester confirmation, promotion evidence or a deployable rule. Only a passing information clue may later be considered for one isolated non-Master Tester after a whole-map comparison.

acquisition_contract.copy_rule: One physical minimal copy from the neutral Lab runtime. No executable, source, settings, state, log or runtime dependency from Live, Optimization or another Lab family.
acquisition_contract.request: One US500 TIMEFRAME_M15 copy_rates_range call from 2022-07-01 00:00:00 through 2026-08-21 23:59:59 UTC request coordinates.
acquisition_contract.forbidden_api_calls: Every account, position, order, deal, history-deal, margin, check, send or trading-state API.
acquisition_contract.freeze: Hash the bar export, visible symbol spec and acquisition receipt before the one formal economic aggregation.

implementation.premetric_design_correction: Before any Unit105 economic value was calculated, execution order was corrected so all four structural paths and P1 parity complete before economics. The first protected structural invocation then reproduced every aggregate, signal score, impulse and M15 coordinate but exposed that the gate incorrectly demanded real-tick seconds although the declared proxy timestamps are bar opens. The gate was corrected to exact M15 bar-coordinate, horizon and sign identity; exact real-tick timestamp matches remain descriptive. Signal, period, fill, metric, threshold and economic gates did not change.
implementation.role: One acquisition helper and one frozen research aggregation. Neither is a validator, parity-checker product, test harness, reusable CLI or trading executable. Structural parity is an in-process integrity gate before economics.

requirements: Every declared Unit027 provenance, script and structural-anchor byte/hash pin matches.
The acquired bar and symbol-spec byte/hash pins match the acquisition receipt; epochs are unique and strictly increasing; OHLC is finite and positive; volume and spread fields are nonnegative.
The visible US500 specification remains digits 2, point 0.01, tick size 0.01, tick value 0.01, contract size 1.0 and minimum/step volume 0.01.
P1 reproduces 366 normal days, 33,453 evaluations, 1,264 triggers, 1,264 resolutions, zero unresolved and zero rate/tick/profit faults.

All 1,264 P1 trigger and resolution M15 bar coordinates, four-bar horizons and impulse signs match the non-economic Unit027 anchor exactly; maximum score difference is at most 5e-10 and signed-impulse difference at most 5e-12. Parent first-tick seconds are descriptive because the frozen proxy uses bar opens.
Every period has zero rate, tick and profit faults and resolved equals triggers minus at most one unresolved tail.
fixed_integrity_gate.failure_meaning: A failed integrity requirement is an engineering, environment or design correction with no economic verdict and no retry cap while the economic contract remains unchanged.

fixed_aggregation.path_metrics: Normal days, resolved opportunities, opportunities per normal day, and for observed and double-spread books net USD, wins, losses, zeros, gross profit/loss, profit factor and maximum closed drawdown.
fixed_aggregation.pooled_metrics: Concatenate fixed 0.01 rows without compounding and compute the same metrics, positive-period count and maximum positive-path contribution share.
fixed_aggregation.maximum_closed_drawdown: Largest peak-to-subsequent-trough decline in the ordered closed cumulative proxy-profit path, starting from zero.
fixed_aggregation.zero_profit: Retain in opportunity count but exclude from profit-factor numerator and denominator.

frequency: At least 0.50 resolved opportunities per normal day pooled.
At least 0.25 resolved opportunities per normal day in at least three of four periods.
economic_for_one_direction: Pooled double-spread profit factor at least 1.10.
Positive double-spread net in at least three of four periods.
Pooled double-spread net divided by pooled maximum closed drawdown at least 1.50.
No one period contributes more than 70 percent of total positive-period double-spread profit.
fixed_selection_gate.selection: Select at most one passing direction by higher pooled double-spread net, then higher profit factor, then more positive periods, then lexicographic direction name.
fixed_selection_gate.nominal_and_practical_judgment: Report every exact nominal gate and the complete economic magnitudes. Because these are the unchanged Unit027 gates, Unit105 does not silently relax them; any broader practical interpretation must remain descriptive and cannot create a passing seed.

fixed_verdict_rules.pass: PASS_US500_SHOCK_RESPONSE_<DIRECTION>_RETAIN_ONE_PROTOTYPE_INFORMATION_SEED when integrity, every frequency gate and every economic gate pass for the selected direction.
fixed_verdict_rules.failure: FAIL_US500_SHOCK_RESPONSE_NO_DIRECTION_NO_SEED when integrity passes but neither direction passes the complete fixed gate.
fixed_verdict_rules.correction: Any acquisition, source, environment, design, invocation, implementation, parser, serialization, parity or packaging fault is corrected without economic verdict and without arbitrary retry limit.
fixed_verdict_rules.pass_action: Retain one information seed only. After closing Unit105 and recomparing the whole map, it may justify at most one separately declared standalone additive prototype and only then one dedicated non-Master single Strategy Tester if it remains the most informative clue.
fixed_verdict_rules.failure_action: Retain no shock-response seed and do not rescue with another threshold, rearm, impulse, baseline, horizon, session, direction subgroup, spread stress, symbol or period.

exclusions: another score threshold, rearm level, impulse window, baseline length, variance estimator, horizon or overlap rule
session, weekday, direction-sign, volatility, spread, event, price-level, month, period or symbol subgroup
stop, take-profit, lot, sizing, weight, priority, capacity, slot, capital, admission, compounding or portfolio reconstruction
MQL copy or edit, compile, Strategy Tester, optimization mutation, test, validator, broker/account query or Live action inside Unit105
formal use of the invalid Unit027 economic columns
automatic prototype, MT5 path, Optimization candidate or Live handoff after a pass

execution_budget.engineering_environment_design_or_serial: unlimited before one valid result while the frozen economic contract remains unchanged

stop_rules: Freeze this declaration before the dedicated market acquisition and before any Unit105 economic output.
Declaration through closure is one research unit and receives one main commit/push only after closure, not at internal acquisition or correction boundaries.
Acquire one immutable M15 surface, freeze its receipt, then run exactly one valid fixed aggregation. Corrections that produce no valid economics do not consume an economic rerun.
Do not inspect or aggregate the invalid Unit027 economic columns; use its copied six-field signal anchor only for structural integrity.
Do not change a signal, period, proxy fill, metric, threshold or gate after a valid economic result.
Close the entire fixed direction bundle together and perform a whole-map comparison before any later action.
Do not start Live or Master, query broker/account/position/order/deal state, create tests or validators, or open Program6.
